name: Application
description: Represents the entire Microsoft Excel application.
remarks: The Application object contains: - Application-wide settings and options. - Methods that return top-level objects, such as ActiveCell, ActiveSheet, and so on.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveCell
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the active cell in the active window (the window on top) or in the specified window. If the window isn't displaying a worksheet, this property fails. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveChart
properties.description: Returns a Chart object that represents the active chart (either an embedded chart or a chart sheet). An embedded chart is considered active when it's either selected or activated. When no chart is active, this property returns Nothing.

properties.name: ActivePrinter
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the active printer. Read/write String.

properties.name: ActiveSheet
properties.description: Returns an object that represents the active sheet (the sheet on top) in the active workbook or in the specified window or workbook. Returns Nothing if no sheet is active.

properties.name: ActiveWindow
properties.description: Returns a Window object that represents the active Excel window (the window on top). Returns Nothing if there are no windows open. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveWorkbook
properties.description: Returns a Workbook object that represents the workbook in the active window (the window on top). Returns Nothing if there are no windows open or if either the Info window or the Clipboard window is the active window. Read-only.

properties.name: AddIns
properties.description: Returns an AddIns collection that represents all the add-ins listed in the Add-Ins dialog box (Add-Ins command on the Developer tab). Read-only.

properties.name: Cells
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the cells on the active worksheet. If the active document is not a worksheet, this property fails.

properties.name: Charts
properties.description: Returns a Sheets collection that represents all the chart sheets in the active workbook.

properties.name: Columns
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the columns on the active worksheet. If the active document isn't a worksheet, the Columns property fails.

properties.name: CommandBars
properties.description: Returns a CommandBars object that represents the Microsoft Excel command bars. Read-only.

properties.name: DDEAppReturnCode
properties.description: Returns the application-specific DDE return code that was contained in the last DDE acknowledge message received by Microsoft Excel. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Names
properties.description: Returns a Names collection that represents all the names in the active workbook. Read-only Names object.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents a cell or a range of cells.

properties.name: Rows
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the rows on the active worksheet. If the active document isn't a worksheet, the Rows property fails. Read-only Range object.

properties.name: Selection
properties.description: Returns the currently selected object on the active worksheet for an Application object. Returns Nothing if no objects are selected. Use the Select method to set the selection, and use the TypeName function to discover the kind of object that is selected.

properties.name: Sheets
properties.description: Returns a Sheets collection that represents all the sheets in the active workbook. Read-only Sheets object.

properties.name: ThisWorkbook
properties.description: Returns a Workbook object that represents the workbook where the current macro code is running. Read-only.

properties.name: Windows
properties.description: Returns a Windows collection that represents all the windows in all the workbooks. Read-only Windows object.

properties.name: Workbooks
properties.description: Returns a Workbooks collection that represents all the open workbooks. Read-only.

properties.name: WorksheetFunction
properties.description: Returns the WorksheetFunction object. Read-only.

properties.name: Worksheets
properties.description: For an Application object, returns a Sheets collection that represents all the worksheets in the active workbook.

properties.name: Excel4IntlMacroSheets
properties.description: Returns a Sheets collection that represents all the Microsoft Excel 4.0 international macro sheets in the specified workbook. Read-only.

properties.name: Excel4MacroSheets
properties.description: Returns a Sheets collection that represents all the Microsoft Excel 4.0 macro sheets in the specified workbook. Read-only.

properties.name: AlertBeforeOverwriting
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel displays a message before overwriting nonblank cells during a drag-and-drop editing operation. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AltStartupPath
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the alternate startup folder. Read/write String.

properties.name: AskToUpdateLinks
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel asks the user to update links when opening files with links. False if links are automatically updated with no dialog box. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutoCorrect
properties.description: Returns an AutoCorrect object that represents the Microsoft Excel AutoCorrect attributes. Read-only.

properties.name: Build
properties.description: Returns the Microsoft Excel build number. Read-only Long.

properties.name: CalculateBeforeSave
properties.description: True if workbooks are calculated before they're saved to disk (if the Calculation property is set to xlManual). This property is preserved even if you change the Calculation property. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Calculation
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlCalculation value that represents the calculation mode.

properties.name: Caller
properties.description: Returns information about how Visual Basic was called (for more information, see the Remarks section).

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the name that appears in the title bar of the main Microsoft Excel window.

properties.name: CellDragAndDrop
properties.description: True if dragging and dropping cells is enabled. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ClipboardFormats
properties.description: Returns the formats that are currently on the Clipboard, as an array of numeric values. To determine whether a particular format is on the Clipboard, compare each element in the array with the appropriate constant listed in the Remarks section. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: DisplayClipboardWindow
properties.description: Returns True if the Microsoft Office Clipboard can be displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CommandUnderlines
properties.description: Returns or sets the state of the command underlines in Microsoft Excel for the Macintosh. Can be one of the constants of XlCommandUnderlines. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ConstrainNumeric
properties.description: True if handwriting recognition is limited to numbers and punctuation only. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CopyObjectsWithCells
properties.description: True if objects are cut, copied, extracted, and sorted with cells. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Cursor
properties.description: Returns or sets the appearance of the mouse pointer in Microsoft Excel. Read/write XlMousePointer.

properties.name: CustomListCount
properties.description: Returns the number of defined custom lists (including built-in lists). Read-only Long.

properties.name: CutCopyMode
properties.description: Returns or sets the status of Cut or Copy mode. Can be True, False, or an XLCutCopyMode constant, as shown in the following tables. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DataEntryMode
properties.description: Returns or sets Data Entry mode, as shown in the following table. When in Data Entry mode, you can enter data only in the unlocked cells in the currently selected range. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DefaultFilePath
properties.description: Returns or sets the default path that Microsoft Excel uses when it opens files. Read/write String.

properties.name: Dialogs
properties.description: Returns a Dialogs collection that represents all built-in dialog boxes. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayAlerts
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel displays certain alerts and messages while a macro is running. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayFormulaBar
properties.description: True if the formula bar is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayFullScreen
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel is in full-screen mode. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayNoteIndicator
properties.description: True if cells containing notes display cell tips and contain note indicators (small dots in their upper-right corners). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayCommentIndicator
properties.description: Returns or sets the way cells display comments and indicators. Can be one of the XlCommentDisplayMode constants.

properties.name: DisplayExcel4Menus
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel displays version 4.0 menu bars. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayRecentFiles
properties.description: True if the list of recently used files is displayed in the UI. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayScrollBars
properties.description: True if scroll bars are visible for all workbooks. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayStatusBar
properties.description: True if the status bar is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EditDirectlyInCell
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel allows editing in cells. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableAutoComplete
properties.description: True if the AutoComplete feature is enabled. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableCancelKey
properties.description: Controls how Microsoft Excel handles Ctrl+Break (or Esc or Command+Period) user interruptions to the running procedure. Read/write XlEnableCancelKey.

properties.name: EnableSound
properties.description: True if sound is enabled for Microsoft Office. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FileConverters
properties.description: Returns information about installed file converters. Returns null if there are no converters installed. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: FixedDecimal
properties.description: All data entered after this property is set to True will be formatted with the number of fixed decimal places set by the FixedDecimalPlaces property. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FixedDecimalPlaces
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of fixed decimal places used when the FixedDecimal property is set to True. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the height, in points, of the main application window.

properties.name: IgnoreRemoteRequests
properties.description: True if remote DDE requests are ignored. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Interactive
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel is in interactive mode; this property is usually True. If you set this property to False, Excel blocks all input from the keyboard and mouse (except input to dialog boxes that are displayed by your code). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: International
properties.description: Returns information about the current country/region and international settings. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Iteration
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel uses iteration to resolve circular references. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the screen to the left edge of the main Microsoft Excel window.

properties.name: LibraryPath
properties.description: Returns the path to the Library folder, but without the final separator. Read-only String.

properties.name: MailSession
properties.description: Returns the MAPI mail session number as a hexadecimal string (if there's an active session), or returns null if there's no session. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: MailSystem
properties.description: Returns the mail system that's installed on the host machine. Read-only XlMailSystem.

properties.name: MathCoprocessorAvailable
properties.description: True if a math coprocessor is available. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: MaxChange
properties.description: Returns or sets the maximum amount of change between each iteration as Microsoft Excel resolves circular references. Read/write Double.

properties.name: MaxIterations
properties.description: Returns or sets the maximum number of iterations that Microsoft Excel can use to resolve a circular reference. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MouseAvailable
properties.description: True if a mouse is available. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: MoveAfterReturn
properties.description: True if the active cell is moved as soon as the Enter (Return) key is pressed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MoveAfterReturnDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the direction in which the active cell is moved when the user presses Enter. Read/write XlDirection.

properties.name: RecentFiles
properties.description: Returns a RecentFiles collection that represents the list of recently used files.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: NetworkTemplatesPath
properties.description: Returns the network path where templates are stored. If the network path doesn't exist, this property returns an empty string. Read-only String.

properties.name: ODBCErrors
properties.description: Returns an ODBCErrors collection that contains all the ODBC errors generated by the most recent query table or PivotTable report operation. Read-only.

properties.name: ODBCTimeout
properties.description: Returns or sets the ODBC query time limit, in seconds. The default value is 45 seconds. Read/write Long.

properties.name: OnWindow
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the procedure that's run whenever you activate a window. Read/write String.

properties.name: OperatingSystem
properties.description: Returns the name and version number of the current operating system. Read-only String.

properties.name: OrganizationName
properties.description: Returns the registered organization name. Read-only String.

properties.name: Path
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the complete path to the application, excluding the final separator and name of the application.

properties.name: PathSeparator
properties.description: Returns the path separator character (\). Read-only String.

properties.name: PreviousSelections
properties.description: Returns an array of the last four ranges or names selected. Each element in the array is a Range object. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: PivotTableSelection
properties.description: True if PivotTable reports use structured selection. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PromptForSummaryInfo
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel asks for summary information when files are first saved. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RecordRelative
properties.description: True if macros are recorded by using relative references; False if recording is absolute. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: ReferenceStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets how Microsoft Excel displays cell references and row and column headings in either A1 or R1C1 reference style. Read/write XlReferenceStyle.

properties.name: RegisteredFunctions
properties.description: Returns information about functions in either dynamic-link libraries (DLLs) or code resources that were registered with the REGISTER or REGISTER.ID macro functions. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: RollZoom
properties.description: True if the IntelliMouse zooms instead of scrolling. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ScreenUpdating
properties.description: True if screen updating is turned on. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SheetsInNewWorkbook
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of sheets that Microsoft Excel automatically inserts into new workbooks. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ShowChartTipNames
properties.description: True if charts show chart tip names. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowChartTipValues
properties.description: True if charts show chart tip values. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: StandardFont
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the standard font. Read/write String.

properties.name: StandardFontSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the standard font size, in points. Read/write Long.

properties.name: StartupPath
properties.description: Returns the complete path of the startup folder, excluding the final separator. Read-only String.

properties.name: StatusBar
properties.description: Returns or sets the text in the status bar. Read/write String.

properties.name: TemplatesPath
properties.description: Returns the local path where templates are stored. Read-only String.

properties.name: ShowToolTips
properties.description: True if ToolTips are turned on. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of the screen to the top edge of the main Microsoft Excel window.

properties.name: DefaultSaveFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets the default format for saving files. For a list of valid constants, see the FileFormat property. Read/write Long.

properties.name: TransitionMenuKey
properties.description: Returns or sets the Microsoft Excel menu or help key, which is usually /. Read/write String.

properties.name: TransitionMenuKeyAction
properties.description: Returns or sets the action taken when the Microsoft Excel menu key is pressed. Can be either xlExcelMenus or xlLotusHelp (see the Excel constants enumeration). Read/write Long.

properties.name: TransitionNavigKeys
properties.description: True if transition navigation keys are active. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: UsableHeight
properties.description: Returns the maximum height of the space that a window can occupy in the application window area, in points. Read-only Double.

properties.name: UsableWidth
properties.description: Returns the maximum width of the space that a window can occupy in the application window area, in points. Read-only Double.

properties.name: UserControl
properties.description: True if the application is visible or if it was created or started by the user. False if you created or started the application programmatically by using the CreateObject or GetObject functions, and the application is hidden. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: UserName
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the current user. Read/write String.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the application.

properties.name: VBE
properties.description: Returns a VBE object that represents the Visual Basic Editor. Read-only.

properties.name: Version
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the Microsoft Excel version number.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that determines whether the object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the application window to its right edge.

properties.name: WindowsForPens
properties.description: True if the computer is running under Microsoft Windows for Pen Computing. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: WindowState
properties.description: Returns or sets the state of the window. Read/write XlWindowState.

properties.name: DefaultSheetDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the default direction in which Microsoft Excel displays new windows and worksheets. Can be one of the following XlReadingOrder constants: xlRTL (right to left) or xlLTR (left to right). Read/write Long.

properties.name: CursorMovement
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether a visual cursor or a logical cursor is used. Can be one of the following constants: xlVisualCursor or xlLogicalCursor. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ControlCharacters
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel displays control characters for right-to-left languages. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableEvents
properties.description: True if events are enabled for the specified object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ExtendList
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel automatically extends formatting and formulas to new data that is added to a list. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: OLEDBErrors
properties.description: Returns the OLEDBErrors collection, which represents the error information returned by the most recent OLE DB query. Read-only.

properties.name: COMAddIns
properties.description: Returns the COMAddIns collection for Microsoft Excel, which represents the currently installed COM add-ins. Read-only.

properties.name: DefaultWebOptions
properties.description: Returns the DefaultWebOptions object that contains global application-level attributes used by Microsoft Excel whenever you save a document as a webpage or open a webpage. Read-only.

properties.name: ProductCode
properties.description: Returns the globally unique identifier (GUID) for Microsoft Excel. Read-only String.

properties.name: UserLibraryPath
properties.description: Returns the path to the location on the user's computer where the COM add-ins are installed. Read-only String.

properties.name: AutoPercentEntry
properties.description: True if entries in cells formatted as percentages aren't automatically multiplied by 100 as soon as they are entered. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LanguageSettings
properties.description: Returns the LanguageSettings object, which contains information about the language settings in Microsoft Excel. Read-only.

properties.name: CalculationVersion
properties.description: Returns a number whose rightmost four digits are the minor calculation engine version number, and whose other digits (on the left) are the major version of Microsoft Excel. Read-only Long.

properties.name: FeatureInstall
properties.description: Returns or sets a value (constant) that specifies how Microsoft Excel handles calls to methods and properties that require features that aren't yet installed. Can be one of the MsoFeatureInstall constants listed in the following table. Read/write MsoFeatureInstall.

properties.name: Ready
properties.description: Returns True when the Microsoft Excel application is ready; False when the Excel application is not ready. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: FindFormat
properties.description: Sets or returns the search criteria for the type of cell formats to find.

properties.name: ReplaceFormat
properties.description: Sets the replacement criteria to use in replacing cell formats. The replacement criteria is then used in a subsequent call to the Replace method of the Range object.

properties.name: UsedObjects
properties.description: Returns a UsedObjects object representing objects allocated in a workbook. Read-only.

properties.name: CalculationState
properties.description: Returns an XlCalculationState constant that indicates the calculation state of the application, for any calculations that are being performed in Microsoft Excel. Read-only.

properties.name: CalculationInterruptKey
properties.description: Sets or returns an XlCalculationInterruptKey constant that specifies the key that can interrupt Microsoft Excel when performing calculations. Read/write.

properties.name: Watches
properties.description: Returns a Watches object representing a range that is tracked when the worksheet is recalculated.

properties.name: DisplayFunctionToolTips
properties.description: True if function ToolTips can be displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutomationSecurity
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoAutomationSecurity constant that represents the security mode that Microsoft Excel uses when programmatically opening files. Read/write.

properties.name: FileDialog
properties.description: Returns a FileDialog object representing an instance of the file dialog.

properties.name: DisplayPasteOptions
properties.description: True if the Paste Options button can be displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayInsertOptions
properties.description: True if the Insert Options button should be displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: GenerateGetPivotData
properties.description: Returns True when Microsoft Excel can get PivotTable report data. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutoRecover
properties.description: Returns an AutoRecover object, which backs up all file formats on a timed interval.

properties.name: Hwnd
properties.description: Returns a Long indicating the top-level window handle of the Microsoft Excel window. Read-only.

properties.name: Hinstance
properties.description: Returns a handle to the instance of Excel represented by the Application object. Read-only Long.

properties.name: ErrorCheckingOptions
properties.description: Returns an ErrorCheckingOptions object, which represents the error checking options for an application.

properties.name: AutoFormatAsYouTypeReplaceHyperlinks
properties.description: True (default) if Microsoft Excel automatically formats hyperlinks as you type. False if Excel does not automatically format hyperlinks as you type. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: NewWorkbook
properties.description: Returns a NewFile object.

properties.name: SpellingOptions
properties.description: Returns a SpellingOptions object that represents the spelling options of the application.

properties.name: Speech
properties.description: Returns a Speech object.

properties.name: MapPaperSize
properties.description: True if documents formatted for the standard paper size of another country/region (for example, A4) are automatically adjusted so that they're printed correctly on the standard paper size (for example, Letter) of your country/region. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowStartupDialog
properties.description: Returns True (default is False) when the New Workbook task pane appears for a Microsoft Excel application. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DecimalSeparator
properties.description: Sets or returns the character used for the decimal separator as a String. Read/write.

properties.name: ThousandsSeparator
properties.description: Sets or returns the character used for the thousands separator as a String. Read/write.

properties.name: UseSystemSeparators
properties.description: True (default) if the system separators of Microsoft Excel are enabled. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ThisCell
properties.description: Returns the cell in which the user-defined function is being called from as a Range object.

properties.name: RTD
properties.description: Returns an RTD object.

properties.name: DisplayDocumentActionTaskPane
properties.description: Set to True to display the Document Actions task pane; set to False to hide the Document Actions task pane. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ArbitraryXMLSupportAvailable
properties.description: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the XML features in Microsoft Excel are available. Read-only.

properties.name: MeasurementUnit
properties.description: Specifies the measurement unit used in the application. Read/write XlMeasurementUnits.

properties.name: ShowSelectionFloaties
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether Mini toolbars displays when a user selects text. False if Mini toolbars are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowMenuFloaties
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to display Mini toolbars when the user right-clicks in the workbook window. False if Mini toolbars are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowDevTools
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether the Developer tab is displayed in the ribbon. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableLivePreview
properties.description: Sets or returns a Boolean that represents whether to show or hide gallery previews that appear when using galleries that support previewing. Setting this property to True shows a preview of your workbook before applying the command. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayDocumentInformationPanel
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether the document properties panel is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AlwaysUseClearType
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to use ClearType to display fonts in the menu, ribbon, and dialog box text. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: WarnOnFunctionNameConflict
properties.description: The WarnOnFunctionNameConflict property, when set to True, raises an alert if a developer tries to create a new function by using an existing function name. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FormulaBarHeight
properties.description: Allows the user to specify the height of the formula bar in lines. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DisplayFormulaAutoComplete
properties.description: Gets or sets whether to show a list of relevant functions and defined names when building cell formulas. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: GenerateTableRefs
properties.description: The GenerateTableRefs property determines whether the traditional notation method or the new structured referencing notation method is used for referencing tables in formulas. Read/write.

properties.name: Assistance
properties.description: Returns an IAssistance object for Microsoft Excel that represents the Microsoft Office Help Viewer. Read-only.

properties.name: EnableLargeOperationAlert
properties.description: Sets or returns a Boolean that represents whether to display an alert message when a user attempts to perform an operation that affects a larger number of cells than is specified in the Office Center UI. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LargeOperationCellThousandCount
properties.description: Returns or sets the maximum number of cells needed in an operation beyond which an alert is triggered. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DeferAsyncQueries
properties.description: Gets or sets whether asynchronous queries to OLAP data sources are executed when a worksheet is calculated by VBA code. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MultiThreadedCalculation
properties.description: Returns a MultiThreadedCalculation object that controls the multi-threaded recalculation settings. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveEncryptionSession
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the encryption session associated with the active document. Read-only.

properties.name: HighQualityModeForGraphics
properties.description: Returns or sets whether Excel uses high quality mode to print graphics. Read/write.

properties.name: FileExportConverters
properties.description: Returns a FileExportConverters collection that represents all the file converters for saving files available to Microsoft Excel. Read-only.

properties.name: SmartArtLayouts
properties.description: Returns the set of SmartArtLayouts that are currently loaded in the application. Read-only.

properties.name: SmartArtQuickStyles
properties.description: Returns the set of SmartArtQuickStyles that are currently loaded in the application. Read-only.

properties.name: SmartArtColors
properties.description: Returns the set of SmartArtColors styles that are currently loaded in the application. Read-only.

properties.name: AddIns2
properties.description: Returns an AddIns2 collection that represents all the add-ins that are currently available or open in Microsoft Excel, regardless of whether they are installed. Read-only.

properties.name: PrintCommunication
properties.description: Specifies whether communication with the printer is turned on. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: UseClusterConnector
properties.description: Returns or sets whether Excel allows user-defined functions in XLL add-ins to be run on a compute cluster. Read/write.

properties.name: ClusterConnector
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the High Performance Computing (HPC) Cluster Connector that is used to run user-defined functions in XLL add-ins. Read/write.

properties.name: ProtectedViewWindows
properties.description: Returns a ProtectedViewWindows collection that represents all the Protected View windows that are open in the application. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveProtectedViewWindow
properties.description: Returns a ProtectedViewWindow object that represents the active Protected View window (the window on top). Returns Nothing if there are no Protected View windows open. Read-only.

properties.name: IsSandboxed
properties.description: Returns True if the specified workbook is open in a Protected View window. Read-only.

properties.name: HinstancePtr
properties.description: Returns a handle to the instance of Excel represented by the specified Application object. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: FileValidation
properties.description: Returns or sets how Excel will validate files before opening them. Read/write.

properties.name: FileValidationPivot
properties.description: Returns or sets how Excel will validate the contents of the data caches for PivotTable reports. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowQuickAnalysis
properties.description: Controls whether the Quick Analysis contextual user interface is displayed on selection. True means that the Quick Analysis button will show.

properties.name: QuickAnalysis
properties.description: Returns a QuickAnalysis object that represents the Quick Analysis options of the application.

properties.name: FlashFill
properties.description: True indicates that the Excel Flash Fill feature has been enabled and active. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableMacroAnimations
properties.description: Controls whether macro animations are enabled. True if user interface animations or chart animations are enabled. Is set to False (no animation) by default. If it is set to True during the running of a macro, it will enable animation, and then will reset to False after the macro runs. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ChartDataPointTrack
properties.description: True causes all charts in newly created documents to use the cell reference tracking behavior. Boolean.

properties.name: FlashFillMode
properties.description: True if the Flash Fill feature is enabled. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MergeInstances
properties.description: True to merge multiple instances of the application into a single instance. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableCheckFileExtensions
properties.description: True to enable the Tell me if Microsoft Excel isn't the default program for viewing and editing spreadsheets dialog box. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SensitivityLabelPolicy
properties.description: Returns the sensitivity label policy for the Application object.

methods.name: Calculate
methods.description: Calculates all open workbooks, a specific worksheet in a workbook, or a specified range of cells on a worksheet, as shown in the following table.

methods.name: DDEExecute
methods.signature: DDEExecute(Channel As Long, String As String)
methods.description: Runs a command or performs some other action or actions in another application by way of the specified DDE channel.

parameters.name: Channel

parameters.name: Channel

parameters.name: Item

methods.name: DDETerminate

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.description: The channel number returned by the DDEInitiate method.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Converts a Microsoft Excel name to an object or a value.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: A formula or the name of the object, using the naming convention of Microsoft Excel. The length of the name must be less than or equal to 255 characters.

methods.name: ExecuteExcel4Macro
methods.description: Runs a Microsoft Excel 4.0 macro function and then returns the result of the function. The return type depends on the function.

parameters.name: String
parameters.description: A Microsoft Excel 4.0 macro language function without the equal sign. All references must be given as R1C1 strings. If _String_ contains embedded double quotation marks, you must double them. For example, to run the macro function =MID("sometext",1,4), _String_ would have to be "MID(""sometext"",1,4)".

methods.description: Returns a Range object that represents the rectangular intersection of two or more ranges. If one or more ranges from a different worksheet are specified, an error is returned.

parameters.name: Arg1
parameters.description: The intersecting ranges. At least two Range objects must be specified.

parameters.name: Arg2
parameters.description: The intersecting ranges. At least two Range objects must be specified.

methods.signature: Run([Macro As Variant], [Arg1 As Variant], [Arg2 As Variant], [Arg3 As Variant], [Arg4 As Variant], [Arg5 As Variant], [Arg6 As Variant], [Arg7 As Variant], [Arg8 As Variant], [Arg9 As Variant], [Arg10 As Variant], [Arg11 As Variant], [Arg12 As Variant], [Arg13 As Variant], [Arg14 As Variant], [Arg15 As Variant], [Arg16 As Variant], [Arg17 As Variant], [Arg18 As Variant], [Arg19 As Variant], [Arg20 As Variant], [Arg21 As Variant], [Arg22 As Variant], [Arg23 As Variant], [Arg24 As Variant], [Arg25 As Variant], [Arg26 As Variant], [Arg27 As Variant], [Arg28 As Variant], [Arg29 As Variant], [Arg30 As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Runs a macro or calls a function. This can be used to run a macro written in Visual Basic or the Microsoft Excel macro language, or to run a function in a DLL or XLL.

parameters.name: Macro
parameters.description: The macro to run. This can be either a string with the macro name, a Range object indicating where the function is, or a register ID for a registered DLL (XLL) function. If a string is used, the string will be evaluated in the context of the active sheet.

methods.name: SendKeys
methods.description: Sends keystrokes to the active application.

parameters.name: Keys
parameters.description: The key or key combination that you want to send to the application, as text.

parameters.name: Wait
parameters.description: True to have Microsoft Excel wait for the keys to be processed before returning control to the macro. False (or omitted) to continue running the macro without waiting for the keys to be processed.

methods.name: Union
methods.signature: Union(Arg1 As Range, Arg2 As Range, [Arg3 As Variant], [Arg4 As Variant], [Arg5 As Variant], [Arg6 As Variant], [Arg7 As Variant], [Arg8 As Variant], [Arg9 As Variant], [Arg10 As Variant], [Arg11 As Variant], [Arg12 As Variant], [Arg13 As Variant], [Arg14 As Variant], [Arg15 As Variant], [Arg16 As Variant], [Arg17 As Variant], [Arg18 As Variant], [Arg19 As Variant], [Arg20 As Variant], [Arg21 As Variant], [Arg22 As Variant], [Arg23 As Variant], [Arg24 As Variant], [Arg25 As Variant], [Arg26 As Variant], [Arg27 As Variant], [Arg28 As Variant], [Arg29 As Variant], [Arg30 As Variant]) As Range
methods.description: Returns the union of two or more ranges.

parameters.name: Arg1
parameters.description: At least two Range objects must be specified.

parameters.name: Arg2
parameters.description: At least two Range objects must be specified.

methods.name: ActivateMicrosoftApp
methods.description: Activates a Microsoft application. If the application is already running, this method activates the running application. If the application isn't running, this method starts a new instance of the application.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies the Microsoft application to activate.

methods.name: AddCustomList
methods.description: Adds a custom list for custom autofill and/or custom sort.

parameters.name: ListArray
parameters.description: Specifies the source data, as either an array of strings or a Range object.

parameters.name: ByRow
parameters.description: Only used if _ListArray_ is a Range object. True to create a custom list from each row in the range. False to create a custom list from each column in the range. If this argument is omitted and there are more rows than columns (or an equal number of rows and columns) in the range, Microsoft Excel creates a custom list from each column in the range. If this argument is omitted and there are more columns than rows in the range, Excel creates a custom list from each row in the range.

methods.name: CentimetersToPoints
methods.description: Converts a measurement from centimeters to points (one point equals 0.035 centimeters).

parameters.name: Centimeters
parameters.description: Specifies the centimeter value to be converted to points.

methods.name: CheckSpelling
methods.signature: CheckSpelling(Word As String, [CustomDictionary As Variant], [IgnoreUppercase As Variant]) As Boolean
methods.description: Checks the spelling of a single word.

parameters.name: Word
parameters.description: (used only with the Application object). The word that you want to check.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary
parameters.description: A string that indicates the file name of the custom dictionary to be examined if the word isn't found in the main dictionary. If this argument is omitted, the currently specified dictionary is used.

parameters.name: IgnoreUppercase
parameters.description: True to have Microsoft Excel ignore words that are all uppercase. False to have Microsoft Excel check words that are all uppercase. If this argument is omitted, the current setting will be used.

methods.name: ConvertFormula
methods.signature: ConvertFormula(Formula As Variant, FromReferenceStyle As XlReferenceStyle, [ToReferenceStyle As Variant], [ToAbsolute As Variant], [RelativeTo As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Converts cell references in a formula between the A1 and R1C1 reference styles, between relative and absolute references, or both. Variant.

parameters.name: Formula
parameters.description: A string that contains the formula that you want to convert. This must be a valid formula, and it must begin with an equal sign.

parameters.name: FromReferenceStyle
parameters.description: The reference style of the formula.

parameters.name: ToReferenceStyle
parameters.description: A constant of XlReferenceStyle specifying the reference style that you want returned. If this argument is omitted, the reference style isn't changed; the formula stays in the style specified by _FromReferenceStyle_.

parameters.name: ToAbsolute
parameters.description: A constant of XlReferenceType that specifies the converted reference type. If this argument is omitted, the reference type isn't changed.

parameters.name: RelativeTo
parameters.description: A Range object that contains one cell. Relative references relate to this cell.

methods.name: DeleteCustomList
methods.description: Deletes a custom list.

parameters.name: ListNum
parameters.description: The custom list number. This number must be greater than or equal to 5 (Microsoft Excel has four built-in custom lists that cannot be deleted).

methods.name: DoubleClick
methods.description: Equivalent to double-clicking the active cell.

methods.name: GetCustomListContents
methods.description: Returns a custom list (an array of strings).

parameters.name: ListNum
parameters.description: The list number.

methods.name: GetCustomListNum
methods.description: Returns the custom list number for an array of strings. Use this method to match both built-in lists and custom-defined lists.

parameters.name: ListArray
parameters.description: An array of strings.

methods.name: GetOpenFilename
methods.signature: GetOpenFilename([FileFilter As Variant], [FilterIndex As Variant], [Title As Variant], [ButtonText As Variant], [MultiSelect As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Displays the standard Open dialog box and gets a file name from the user without actually opening any files.

parameters.name: FileFilter
parameters.description: A string specifying file filtering criteria.

parameters.name: FilterIndex
parameters.description: Specifies the index numbers of the default file filtering criteria, from 1 to the number of filters specified in _FileFilter_. If this argument is omitted or greater than the number of filters present, the first file filter is used.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Specifies the title of the dialog box. If this argument is omitted, the title is "Open."

parameters.name: ButtonText
parameters.description: Macintosh only.

parameters.name: MultiSelect
parameters.description: True to allow multiple file names to be selected. False to allow only one file name to be selected. The default value is False.

methods.name: GetSaveAsFilename
methods.signature: GetSaveAsFilename([InitialFilename As Variant], [FileFilter As Variant], [FilterIndex As Variant], [Title As Variant], [ButtonText As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Displays the standard Save As dialog box and gets a file name from the user without actually saving any files.

parameters.name: InitialFilename
parameters.description: Specifies the suggested file name. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Excel uses the active workbook's name.

parameters.name: FileFilter
parameters.description: A string specifying file filtering criteria. Max length is 255 characters, otherwise the method returns Error 2015.

parameters.name: FilterIndex
parameters.description: Specifies the index number of the default file filtering criteria, from 1 to the number of filters specified in _FileFilter_. If this argument is omitted or greater than the number of filters present, the first file filter is used.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Specifies the title of the dialog box. If this argument is omitted, the default title is used.

parameters.name: ButtonText
parameters.description: Macintosh only.

methods.name: Goto
methods.description: Selects any range or Visual Basic procedure in any workbook, and activates that workbook if it's not already active.

parameters.name: Reference
parameters.description: The destination. Can be a Range object, a string that contains a cell reference in R1C1-style notation, or a string that contains a Visual Basic procedure name. If this argument is omitted, the destination is the last range you used the Goto method to select.

parameters.name: Scroll
parameters.description: True to scroll through the window so that the upper-left corner of the range appears in the upper-left corner of the window. False to not scroll through the window. The default is False.

methods.name: Help
methods.description: Displays a Help topic.

parameters.name: HelpFile
parameters.description: The name of the online Help file that you want to display. If this argument isn't specified, Microsoft Excel Help is used.

parameters.name: HelpContextID
parameters.description: Specifies the context ID number for the Help topic. If this argument isn't specified, the Help Topics dialog box is displayed.

methods.name: InchesToPoints
methods.description: Converts a measurement from inches to points.

parameters.name: Inches
parameters.description: Specifies the inch value to be converted to points.

methods.name: InputBox
methods.signature: InputBox(Prompt As String, [Title As Variant], [Default As Variant], [Left As Variant], [Top As Variant], [HelpFile As Variant], [HelpContextID As Variant], [Type As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Displays a dialog box for user input. Returns the information entered in the dialog box.

parameters.name: Prompt
parameters.description: The message to be displayed in the dialog box. This can be a string, a number, a date, or a Boolean value (Microsoft Excel automatically coerces the value to a String before it is displayed). Maximum length is 255 characters, otherwise there is no prompt, and Application's method immediately returns Error 2015.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The title for the input box. If this argument is omitted, the default title is Input.

parameters.name: Default
parameters.description: Specifies a value that will appear in the text box when the dialog box is initially displayed. If this argument is omitted, the text box is left empty. This value can be a Range object.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: Specifies an x position for the dialog box in relation to the upper-left corner of the screen, in points.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: Specifies a y position for the dialog box in relation to the upper-left corner of the screen, in points.

parameters.name: HelpFile
parameters.description: The name of the Help file for this input box. If the _HelpFile_ and _HelpContextID_ arguments are present, a Help button will appear in the dialog box.

parameters.name: HelpContextID
parameters.description: The context ID number of the Help topic in _HelpFile_.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies the return data type. If this argument is omitted, the dialog box returns text.

methods.name: MailLogoff
methods.description: Closes a MAPI mail session established by Microsoft Excel.

methods.name: MailLogon
methods.signature: MailLogon([Name As Variant], [Password As Variant], [DownloadNewMail As Variant])
methods.description: Logs on to MAPI Mail or Microsoft Exchange and establishes a mail session. If Microsoft Mail isn't already running, you must use this method to establish a mail session before mail or document routing functions can be used.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The mail account name or Microsoft Exchange profile name. If this argument is omitted, the default mail account name is used.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The mail account password. This argument is ignored in Microsoft Exchange.

parameters.name: DownloadNewMail
parameters.description: True to download new mail immediately.

methods.name: NextLetter
methods.description: You have requested Help for a Visual Basic keyword used only on the Macintosh. For information about this keyword, consult the language reference Help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

methods.name: OnKey
methods.description: Runs a specified procedure when a particular key or key combination is pressed.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: A string indicating the key to be pressed.

parameters.name: Procedure
parameters.description: A string indicating the name of the procedure to be run. If _Procedure_ is "" (empty text), nothing happens when _Key_ is pressed. This form of OnKey changes the normal result of keystrokes in Microsoft Excel. If _Procedure_ is omitted, _Key_ reverts to its normal result in Microsoft Excel, and any special key assignments made with previous OnKey methods are cleared.

methods.name: OnRepeat
methods.signature: OnRepeat(Text As String, Procedure As String)
methods.description: Sets the Repeat item and the name of the procedure that will run if you choose the Repeat command after running the procedure that sets this property.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text that appears with the Repeat command.

parameters.name: Procedure
parameters.description: The name of the procedure that will be run when you choose the Repeat command.

methods.name: OnTime
methods.signature: OnTime(EarliestTime As Variant, Procedure As String, [LatestTime As Variant], [Schedule As Variant])
methods.description: Schedules a procedure to be run at a specified time in the future (either at a specific time of day or after a specific amount of time has passed).

parameters.name: EarliestTime
parameters.description: The time when you want this procedure to be run.

parameters.name: Procedure
parameters.description: The name of the procedure to be run.

parameters.name: LatestTime
parameters.description: The latest time at which the procedure can be run. For example, if _LatestTime_ is set to _EarliestTime_ + 30 and Microsoft Excel is not in Ready, Copy, Cut, or Find mode at _EarliestTime_ because another procedure is running, Excel will wait 30 seconds for the first procedure to complete. If Excel is not in Ready mode within 30 seconds, the procedure won't be run. If this argument is omitted, Excel will wait until the procedure can be run.

parameters.name: Schedule
parameters.description: True to schedule a new OnTime procedure. False to clear a previously set procedure. The default value is True.

methods.name: OnUndo
methods.signature: OnUndo(Text As String, Procedure As String)
methods.description: Sets the text of the Undo command and the name of the procedure that's run if you choose the Undo command after running the procedure that sets this property.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text that appears with the Undo command.

parameters.name: Procedure
parameters.description: The name of the procedure that's run when you choose the Undo command.

methods.name: Quit
methods.description: Quits Microsoft Excel.

methods.name: RecordMacro
methods.description: Records code if the macro recorder is on.

parameters.name: BasicCode
parameters.description: A string that specifies the Visual Basic code that will be recorded if the macro recorder is recording into a Visual Basic module. The string will be recorded on one line. If the string contains a carriage return (ASCII character 10, or Chr$(10) in code), it will be recorded on more than one line.

parameters.name: XlmCode
parameters.description: This argument is ignored.

methods.name: RegisterXLL
methods.description: Loads an XLL code resource and automatically registers the functions and commands contained in the resource.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the XLL to be loaded.

methods.name: Repeat
methods.description: Repeats the last user-interface action.

methods.name: Undo
methods.description: Cancels the last user-interface action.

methods.name: Volatile
methods.description: Marks a user-defined function as volatile. A volatile function must be recalculated whenever calculation occurs in any cells on the worksheet. A nonvolatile function is recalculated only when the input variables change. This method has no effect if it's not inside a user-defined function used to calculate a worksheet cell.

parameters.name: Volatile
parameters.description: True to mark the function as volatile. False to mark the function as nonvolatile. The default value is True.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Pauses a running macro until a specified time. Returns True if the specified time has arrived.

parameters.name: Time
parameters.description: The time at which you want the macro to resume, in Microsoft Excel date format.

methods.name: GetPhonetic
methods.description: Returns the Japanese phonetic text of the specified text string. This method is available to you only if you have selected or installed Japanese language support for Microsoft Office.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: Specifies the text to be converted to phonetic text. If you omit this argument, the next possible phonetic text string (if any) of the previously specified _Text_ is returned. If there are no more possible phonetic text strings, an empty string is returned.

methods.name: CalculateFull
methods.description: Forces a full calculation of the data in all open workbooks.

methods.name: FindFile
methods.description: Displays the Open dialog box.

methods.name: CalculateFullRebuild
methods.description: For all open workbooks, forces a full calculation of the data and rebuilds the dependencies.

methods.name: CheckAbort
methods.description: Stops recalculation in a Microsoft Excel application.

parameters.name: KeepAbort
parameters.description: Allows recalculation to be performed for a range.

methods.name: DisplayXMLSourcePane
methods.description: Opens the XML Source task pane and displays the XML map specified by the _XmlMap_ argument.

parameters.name: XmlMap
parameters.description: The XML map to display in the task pane.

methods.name: CalculateUntilAsyncQueriesDone
methods.description: Runs all pending queries to OLEDB and OLAP data sources.

methods.name: SharePointVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of SharePoint Foundation instances running at the site for the specified URL.

parameters.name: bstrUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the site to check.

methods.name: MacroOptions
methods.signature: MacroOptions([Macro As Variant], [Description As Variant], [HasMenu As Variant], [MenuText As Variant], [HasShortcutKey As Variant], [ShortcutKey As Variant], [Category As Variant], [StatusBar As Variant], [HelpContextID As Variant], [HelpFile As Variant], [ArgumentDescriptions As Variant])
methods.description: Corresponds to options in the Macro Options dialog box. You can also use this method to display a user-defined function (UDF) in a built-in or new category within the Insert Function dialog box.

parameters.name: Macro
parameters.description: The macro name or the name of a user-defined function (UDF).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The macro description.

parameters.name: HasMenu
parameters.description: This argument is ignored.

parameters.name: MenuText
parameters.description: This argument is ignored.

parameters.name: HasShortcutKey
parameters.description: True to assign a shortcut key to the macro (_ShortcutKey_ must also be specified). If this argument is False, no shortcut key is assigned to the macro. If the macro already has a shortcut key, setting this argument to False removes the shortcut key. The default value is False.

parameters.name: ShortcutKey
parameters.description: Required if _HasShortcutKey_ is True; ignored otherwise. The shortcut key.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: An integer that specifies an existing macro function category (Financial, Date & Time, or User Defined, for example). See the Remarks section to determine the integers that are mapped to the built-in categories. You can also specify a string for a custom category. If you provide a string, it is treated as the category name that is displayed in the Insert Function dialog box. If the category name has never been used, a new category is defined with that name. If you use a category name that is the same as a built-in name (see list in Remarks section), Excel maps the user-defined function to that built-in category.

parameters.name: StatusBar
parameters.description: The status bar text for the macro.

parameters.name: HelpContextID
parameters.description: An integer that specifies the context ID for the Help topic assigned to the macro.

parameters.name: HelpFile
parameters.description: The name of the Help file that contains the Help topic defined by _HelpContextId_.

parameters.name: ArgumentDescriptions
parameters.description: A one-dimensional array that contains the descriptions for the arguments to a UDF that are displayed in the Function Arguments dialog box.

events.name: SheetPivotTableBeforeAllocateChanges
events.signature: SheetPivotTableBeforeAllocateChanges(Sh As Object, TargetPivotTable As PivotTable, ValueChangeStart As Long, ValueChangeEnd As Long, Cancel As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs before changes are applied to a PivotTable.

parameters.name: Sh
parameters.description: The worksheet that contains the PivotTable.

parameters.name: TargetPivotTable
parameters.description: The PivotTable that contains the changes to apply.

parameters.name: ValueChangeStart
parameters.description: The index to the first change in the associated PivotTableChangeList collection. The index is specified by the Order property of the ValueChange object in the PivotTableChangeList collection.

parameters.name: ValueChangeEnd
parameters.description: The index to the last change in the associated PivotTableChangeList collection. The index is specified by the Order property of the ValueChange object in the PivotTableChangeList collection.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: False when the event occurs. If the event procedure sets this argument to True, the changes are not applied to the PivotTable, and all edits are lost.

events.name: SheetPivotTableBeforeCommitChanges
events.signature: SheetPivotTableBeforeCommitChanges(Sh As Object, TargetPivotTable As PivotTable, ValueChangeStart As Long, ValueChangeEnd As Long, Cancel As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs before changes are committed against the OLAP data source for a PivotTable.

parameters.name: Sh
parameters.description: The worksheet that contains the PivotTable.

parameters.name: TargetPivotTable
parameters.description: The PivotTable that contains the changes to commit.

parameters.name: ValueChangeStart
parameters.description: The index to the first change in the associated PivotTableChangeList object. The index is specified by the Order property of the ValueChange object in the PivotTableChangeList collection.

parameters.name: ValueChangeEnd
parameters.description: The index to the last change in the associated PivotTableChangeList object. The index is specified by the Order property of the ValueChange object in the PivotTableChangeList collection.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: False when the event occurs. If the event procedure sets this argument to True, the changes are not committed against the OLAP data source of the PivotTable.

events.name: SheetPivotTableBeforeDiscardChanges
